    def min_moves(r1, c1, r2, c2, a):

        vertical_moves = abs(r1 - r2)
        
        # Calculate horizontal moves
        if r1 == r2:
            horizontal_moves = abs(c1 - c2)

            # Move to the end of the current line if necessary
            if c1 != a[r1 - 1] + 1:
                horizontal_moves = (a[r1 - 1] + 1 - c1) + c2
            else:
                horizontal_moves = c2
        
        return vertical_moves + horizontal_moves
